Hi Anthony,

Just touching base for your 11:10am Sportscenter phoner with Jade McCarthy, we will ask you the questions below – do you have a head shot of yourself that you can email us that’s a hi-resolution JPEG that we can put on the phoner panel? Thx.
11:10AM SC PHONER WITH JADE MCCARTHY
For more, we welcome in Tigers beat writer for the Detroit Free Press Anthony Fenech...

==Justin Verlander's era is up over 5 in 5 starts this season...but he talked about improvement following his last start july 10th. Only gave up one run in 7 and change. How does Verlander build on that last start today?
==Miguel Cabrera went on the DL a little over two weeks ago for the 1st time in his career with a calf strain...what's the latest on the progress Miggy is making?
==Tigers sit at .500 - 9 and a half games behind the Royals in the AL Central...will the Tigers be buyers or sellers as the July 31st trade deadline approaches?
